claim: Sepilok Orangutan Rehabilitation Centre official Sabah Tourism listing.

claim: Sun Bear Centre open 09:00-15:30 daily with no lunch break; next to the orangutan centre.
quote: The Sun Bear Centre is open every day from 9:00 until 3:30pm and doesn't shut for lunch.

claim: Sun Bear entry RM50 adult, RM25 child for non-Malaysians; under-2 free.
quote: Non-Malaysians pay RM50 (adults) and RM25 (children). Additionally, free admission is available for all children under 2 years old.

claim: Rainforest Discovery Centre official site.

claim: RDC hosts 300+ lowland bird species including Bornean Bristlehead.
quote: over 300 lowland bird species reside... Bornean Bristlehead, Blue-headed Pitta, Sabah Partridge, Bornean Banded Kingfisher.

claim: RDC night walk RM50 adult, RM25 child, cash only.
quote: Adults (15+ years): RM50.00; Children: RM25.00

quote: The night walk runs from 6pm to 8pm after the park officially closes... tarsiers, slow lorises, civets... flying squirrels, tarantulas, scorpions.

claim: Individual Kinabatangan river cruise ~RM55/pax, ~2.5 hours.
quote: Individual river cruises cost 55 MYR per person, with each cruise lasting about 2.5 hours.

claim: 2D1N Sukau/Bilit Kinabatangan package from ~US$146 with cruises and jungle walk.
quote: 2D1N Borneo Natural Sukau Bilit Resort - Kinabatangan River Cruises & Jungle Walk (Budget)

claim: Kinabatangan cruises depart dawn/dusk on tributaries to spot proboscis monkeys, orangutan, macaques, crocodiles, pygmy elephants.
quote: A trip up the river at dawn or dusk is the best opportunity to see Borneo's wildlife... Proboscis Monkeys, Orang Utans... Crocodiles... Borneo Pygmy Elephant.

claim: Kinabatangan peak surcharge RM54/pax Jun 1-Sep 30 2026; 3D2N package from ~US$222.
quote: A peak season surcharge of MYR 54.00 per person is applicable from June 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026.

claim: Gomantong Caves entry RM30 non-Malaysian adult; home to 27 bat species and cave swiftlets.
quote: Gomantong Caves are home to 27 species of bats and four species of cave swiftlet... RM 30 for international adults.

claim: Gomantong is Sabah's largest cave; ~500m boardwalk past bird-nest harvest platforms.
quote: The wooden walkway is approximately 500 meters long and winds through the cave's interior... harvesting platforms up close.

claim: Sandakan-to-Kinabatangan ~2 hr drive; firefly mangrove cruise from RM300/pax incl dinner; kayaking offered.
quote: The journey from Sandakan to the Kinabatangan River takes approximately 2 hours by car... Prices start at MYR 300/pax with a 2pax minimum... includes the boat trip with guide and dinner.

claim: Turtle Islands (Selingan) 2D1N package; high-season surcharge RM70/room/night Jun-Sep 2026.
quote: a high season surcharge of MYR 70.00 per room per night at Selingan Turtle Island (June – September 2026).

claim: Turtle Islands Park 40km north of Sandakan; 3 islands; green and hawksbill nesting; book via Crystal Quest/Sabah Parks.
quote: The Turtle Island Park lies 40km north of Sandakan in the Sulu Sea, comprises of 3 islands... nesting beach and breeding ground for the Green Turtle and Hawksbill Turtle.

claim: Selingan Turtle Island overnight package listed at ~RM1,380.
quote: Selingan Turtle Island - MYR 1,380

claim: Selingan overnight includes watching turtles lay eggs, hatchling release; limited rooms, book ahead.
quote: The overnight stay allows visitors to watch live sea turtle hatchlings and have the exciting opportunity of releasing baby green turtles back to the ocean.

claim: Best months to visit Sandakan are Mar-Aug, with Apr-Jun driest.
quote: the best time to visit Sandakan is from April to June, as it is the one with the least rainfall.

claim: Sandakan NE monsoon Oct-Feb wettest; Dec ~301mm; rain mostly afternoon, mornings clearer.
quote: The rainiest period, with more than 300 mm per month, is from October to February... The wettest month in Sandakan is December, which receives around 301 mm.

claim: Sandakan Heritage Trail is a 1.5-2 hr self-guided loop: Masjid Jamik, Pryer Memorial, 100-step stairs, Agnes Keith House.
quote: The trail takes only about 1.5 to 2 hours to complete... begins at the 100-year old Masjid Jamik, then... the Pryer Memorial... climb the Stairs with a Hundred Steps.

claim: Agnes Keith House is a restored colonial villa museum of the author of accounts of pre/post-WWII Sabah.
quote: the beautifully restored former home of American author Agnes Keith... turned into a museum filled with artefacts from the couple's life.

claim: Puu Jih Shih is a 1987 hilltop Chinese Buddhist temple and one of Sandakan's best sunset viewpoints.
quote: One of Sandakan's best sunset viewing spots is from hilltop Puu Jih Shih Temple, which has commanding views of Sandakan Bay.

claim: Sandakan Central Market is Sabah's biggest/busiest fish market; 3 floors of seafood, produce, handicrafts.
quote: The fish market here is perhaps the biggest and busiest in Sabah which offers a stunning array of fresh seafood.

claim: Central Market has food stalls (noodles, satay, nasi campur, seafood) and local Sandakan coffee.
quote: popular stalls serving noodles, satay, nasi campur, and seafood dishes. The famous Sandakan Kopi.

claim: Buli Sim Sim is the original 1879 townsite of Sandakan, a historic stilt water village.
quote: This is also the site of the original town of Sandakan which began in 1879.

claim: Visitors can take a boat ride to Buli Sim Sim water village to see stilt houses and waterfront eateries.
quote: set sail on a picturesque boat ride to the captivating water village of Buli Sim Sim, where stilt houses gracefully rise above serene waters.

claim: Lankayan is ~1.5 hr by boat from Sandakan; non-divers snorkel/kayak/turtle hatchery; hatchlings Jun-Sep.
quote: about one and a half hours by boat from the port of Sandakan... From June till September, visitors can witness the hatchlings of baby sea turtles.

claim: Lankayan sold as multi-night resort packages (e.g. 3D2N), minimum 2 nights.
quote: 3D2N Lankayan Island

claim: Pulau Berhala is a forested island at Sandakan Bay mouth with beach, lighthouse hike and raptors; guide/permit needed.
quote: This forested island is a habitat for birds especially raptors... a lighthouse provides breathtaking panoramic views... A guide and permit are required for hiking.

claim: Berhala hill hike is a moderate ~1-1.5 hr out-and-back to a lighthouse viewpoint.
quote: moderate hike covering 547 ft elevation gain that takes about 1–1.5 hours to complete.

claim: Sepilok is ~20-25 min / ~RM50 by taxi from Sandakan airport.
quote: from Sandakan airport, it takes around 20 minutes and costs approximately 50RM by taxi.

claim: The Sandakan-Ranau Death March is a multi-day commemorative trekking pilgrimage; Aug 15 memorial service.
quote: the Sandakan-Ranau Death March trekking tour is held as a commemorative pilgrimage to honour the fallen heroes.

claim: Sandakan Memorial Park sits on the former POW camp grounds with an interpretive pavilion and six stations on a circular route past wartime relics.
quote: an interpretive pavilion provides information on the history of the park... The memorial is divided into six stations that are connected by a circular route.

claim: The Sandakan Death Marches killed 2,434 Allied POWs; worst atrocity for Australian servicemen in WWII.
quote: resulted in the deaths of 2,434 Allied prisoners of war... widely considered to be the single worst atrocity suffered by Australian servicemen during the Second World War.
